entries.msgstr: The main objective is to be the last player (or Platoon) standing. Collect resources, upgrade your vehicle, and survive!
Airdrop: XP, HP recovery, module repairs, charges for all Combat Abilities, ammo.
Spoils of War: XP, HP recovery, module repairs, charges for some Combat Abilities, ammo.
Supplies: XP, possible Combat Ability charge, ammo.
Consumables: XP, HP recovery, module repairs, charge for Recovery, ammo.
Spoils of War: XP, HP recovery, module repairs, charges for some Combat Abilities, ammo.
Consumables: XP, HP recovery, module repairs, chance to get charges for Combat Abilities, ammo.
Lucky Seals are contained in all types of Spoils of War. They can be exchanged for rewards after battle in the Shamrock Shop.
Battle for valuable resources under "free-for-all" rules.
